title: ClimateClaw (Freva)
description: ClimateClaw at a Freva instance. Operators set these through settings overrides; nothing here is a credential.

host.title: Freva host
host.description: The Freva instance, e.g. https://freva.example.org. ClimateClaw and the login are reached under it.

apiPath.title: ClimateClaw API path
apiPath.description: Where ClimateClaw is served under the host.

callbackPath.title: Login callback path
callbackPath.description: The sign-in callback, on this page's origin: a path ("/auth/callback/", resolved against this origin) or a same-origin URL. It hands the response back to this tab. Must be registered with the identity provider and in freva-rest's redirect allow-list. Defaults to the page shipped with this extension.

expectedIssuer.title: Expected issuer
expectedIssuer.description: The identity provider's issuer (RFC 9207), when it sends one.

runAndFixModel.title: Run & fix model
runAndFixModel.description: A fast model for "Run & fix at DKRZ". Defaults to the default model.

scopeNote.title: Scope note
scopeNote.description: Prepended to the first message of every new thread and shown in the chat. It steers the assistant; it does not restrict it.

codeToNotebook.title: Code into the notebook
codeToNotebook.description: Code ClimateClaw runs at DKRZ becomes new cells in the open notebook (a new one if none is open), with its output and figures; the chat keeps the explanation and says which cell. Off: code and output are shown in the chat.

hostLabel.title: Host label
hostLabel.description: A short name for the Freva host in the chat header, e.g. DKRZ. Empty: derived from the host (nextgems.dkrz.de -> DKRZ).

hideCode.title: Hide code
hideCode.description: The chat's code toggle: true folds the code of each run in the chat (it still goes into its notebook cell); outputs, errors and figures always show. null: hidden when codeToNotebook, else hideCodeByDefault.

codeDisplay.title: Code display (replaced)
codeDisplay.description: Replaced by hideCode. Kept so settings saved by an earlier version still load; read once into hideCode, then removed.

runModel.title: Run at DKRZ model
runModel.description: The model chosen for Run at DKRZ; null uses runAndFixModel.

previewOrigin.title: Figure origin
previewOrigin.description: The origin ClimateClaw's saved figures are served from (its preview_url), which the notebook may show pictures from. Empty: the host.

registerUrl.title: Registration page
registerUrl.description: Where a visitor without an account registers, linked from the chat's first page (an https URL). Empty hides the note.
